**Which page or section?**
Link to the page on the docs site or the file in `docs/`.

**What is wrong or missing?**
Unclear wording, an error, an outdated command, a missing topic?

**Suggested improvement**
If you already know what the page should say instead, describe it here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked the [API reference](../../docs/reference/api.md) for the function in question
- [ ] This is about documentation, not code behaviour (for behaviour, use the bug template)
